scenes.text: An equation says two quantities are equal. Use inverse operations to solve for the unknown.
Solve x plus 11 equals 33. The answer is 22. x equals 33 minus 11 equals 22.
A box during a sports day has 11 stickers plus x more; altogether there are 34. What is x? Pause to choose and explain.
